customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be among the best in its category, with reliable performance and quick, professional installation by Aquaguard experts. They appreciate its elegant design, good taste, and efficient purification capabilities, considering it good value for money. The service aspect receives mixed reviews, with some customers praising the excellent service while others report poor service experiences.

reviews.title: Good Value for Money
reviews.body: Good water purifier with good water quality. It is easy to use and works well. Overall, I'm satisfied with the product and would recommend it.

reviews.author: Moosa
reviews.title: Excellent Product & Smooth Installation
reviews.body: Great product and excellent value for money. Water tastes clean and fresh, and the purifier works perfectly. Installation was quick and smooth. The technician was professional, explained everything clearly, and checked the TDS after installation. Very satisfied with the purchase. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Ani
reviews.title: Very much satisfied with the purifier
reviews.body: It has only been a few days, and the product looks very promising. The installation team also did a great job. We had a slightly unconventional setup: the RO unit was placed in our wash area, and we connected the purified water outlet to a spout in the kitchen to dispense the RO water. Initially, the technicians were hesitant because they didn't fully understand how to execute the setup, but they later agreed and finished the installation with a neat and professional finish the next day.
